description.value:
This is the favorite among the works of Jane Austen and one of the most beloved and widely read among all English novels.

Its theme is marriage; its story centers around the engaging problems of the Bennet household in finding husbandsfor five marriageable daughters.

Particularly, it is the story of Elizabeth Bennet and Mr. Darcy, who meet and fall in love, only to be estranged by their proud and prejudiced hearts.

Their courtship has kept readers in suspenseful delight for generations. --back cover
